title: Add an admin-only changelog page written on every commit
description: Admins and super admins get a Changelog page listing everything that shipped, newest first, with a feature/improvement/fix tag, a plain-English description, the author, and a link to the commit. A repo-wide rule loaded on every prompt has the agent write each entry right after it commits, so the page stays current without a database - and a request plus its follow-up refinements stays one entry rather than several.
author: Petros Rodinos
sessionNote: Each feature opened with a written spec and clarifying answers that redirected the approach, followed by short directive refinements; no corrections to undo.

title: Consolidate dashboard pages into tabs and tidy settings
description: Five sidebar entries became two tabbed pages: tip distribution now sits beside QR codes on the QR Codes page, and payments and payout history beside the tip ledger on the Tips page, each opening on the primary view with the others reachable at ?tab=. The old /dashboard/distribution, /dashboard/payments and /dashboard/payouts addresses redirect to those tabs, so existing links and bookmarks keep working. In settings, the Review Redirect step folded into the Reviews page and the read-only VAT rate moved from Business Profile to Tax Details, leaving a sidebar of Overview, Employees, Tips, QR Codes, Analytics, Reviews, Alerts and Settings.
author: Petros Rodinos
sessionNote: A steady run of short, specific asks, each naming the page to merge and which view should open first; one layout question answered mid-session, no corrections.

title: Record session tone on changelog entries, add date filters and an AI tag
description: Changelog entries can now show how the session ran - a tag like Focused, Rushed or Blunt plus a one-line note written by the agent at commit time - and admins can filter the page by that tag or by a date range. The agent badge now reads a plain "AI" instead of naming the model.
author: Petros Rodinos
sessionNote: Opened each feature with a written spec and answered the clarifying questions with custom instructions that redirected the approach; the closing asks were a terse two-item todo list.

title: Let a distribution rule pool tips to the business and track what it owes staff
description: A distribution rule can now send the whole tip to the business instead of paying each employee's share to their own bank, for businesses that hand their staff the money themselves. The split percentages still decide what each employee earned, so a Staff balances tab shows a running balance of what is owed to whom; a business records a payment against specific tips, exports it for an accountant, and the employee confirms they received it from their own portal. Because the setting lives on the rule, one business can pool the tips from some QR codes and pay directly from others. The Terms, Privacy Policy and help center explain the arrangement, including that a business collecting tips itself remains responsible for paying its staff.
author: Petros Rodinos
sessionNote: Terse, low-context messages throughout, including one sharp correction that moved the setting onto the distribution rule; a challenge to a proposed acknowledgement screen ended with it being dropped.

title: Add a date range filter to the reviews dashboard
description: The Reviews page now has From and To date pickers beside the rating and employee filters, so customer feedback can be narrowed to a specific window. The To date covers the whole day it names, rather than stopping at midnight and leaving that day out.
author: Petros Rodinos
sessionNote: One short ask naming the page and the filter, then a commit request; the only back-and-forth was a question about repairing a commit message I had mangled.

title: Fix Create distribution rule appearing to do nothing on invalid submit
description: The Create/Edit distribution rule dialog could fail validation (a missing employee, percentages not totaling 100%) without any visible feedback if the erroring field was scrolled out of view below the sticky footer. Submitting an invalid rule now scrolls to and focuses the first problem so it's obvious what needs fixing.
author: Petros Rodinos
sessionNote: Reported the button doing nothing with no other detail; traced it through the form, API, and backend before finding the off-screen validation error as the cause.

title: Let owners add, switch between and delete stores
description: Owners can add more stores from the sidebar store switcher, optionally copying branding, customer messages, localization, tipping, review setup and QR designs from an existing store (copied logos and covers are separate files). A new Settings > Stores page lists every store with a Switch action and an owner-only Delete; the last store, and stores that already have tips or reviews, can't be deleted. Deleting a store also removes its logo, cover and staff photos from storage.
author: Petros Rodinos
sessionNote: Started from a yes/no question and grew through short, direct follow-ups (copy settings, a second step, hiding alerts, a Stores settings page, switching, storage cleanup on delete) with no rework.

title: Move platform finance settings and VAT rate from env vars and stores to an AppConfig table
description: Platform commission, processor fee estimate, payout hold window and the checkout VAT rate are now stored in an app_config table instead of environment variables and per-store settings. Admins and super admins can change them from the new App Config page; changes apply to future tips and payouts only.
author: Petros Rodinos
sessionNote: Short, direct asks with a pasted env block, then a follow-up to move the VAT rate into the same table.
